name: executionConnector.verifyConnection
description: Check local execution connector presence on this API instance. depth=socket tests outbound WebSocket registration; depth=invoke additionally runs a bounded list_dir probe via tool.invoke (same semantics as GET /api/v1/execution-connector/connection-status). Requires feature.local_execution_connector.

user_id.description: User to check (optional, uses session user_id when authenticated)

depth.description: socket (default) or invoke — invoke performs delegated-tool round-trip probe against connector workdir
